You'll design, deploy, and troubleshoot network and VPN solutions, including Palo Alto Prisma Access at global scale, partner with InfoSec to harden network security, and mentor engineers across the team. This role combines deep hands-on networking expertise with the judgment to prioritize and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders. and ongoing management of Palo Alto Prisma Access as MongoDB's SASE , in partnership with InfoSec Administer and evolve MongoDB's network authentication stack, including RADIUS implementations (EAP-TLS, PAP, RadSec and Mac Authentication), ensuring secure and reliable network access Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve network security controls, including VLAN configuration, firewall rules, DNS, DHCP, and IDS/IPS solutions Design and deploy network infrastructure for new and existing global office sites, partnering with Real Estate, workplace, AV, and Physical Security teams Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex network issues across the organization Build automation to reduce manual network operations work and improve reliability and observability Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with ISPs, hardware, low voltage cabling and other network vendors Mentor engineers across the team and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service Responsibilities Ensure MongoDB's global network infrastructure and VPN remain fault tolerant, reliable, secure, and scalable as the company grows Reduce risk and technical debt across network, security and remote access solutions Communicate network strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders Uphold strong engineering practices across network documentation, automation, and change management Balance long-term network architecture work with day-to-day operational support Ability to use iterative designs to PoC and deploy new network solution based on company problems Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 6+ years of experience in network or systems engineering, with a strong grasp of networking fundamentals (OSI model, routing, switching, IP subnetting, cabling, wireless) Proven experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting high availability network infrastructure at global scale, including routers, switches, firewalls, access points and IOT sensors in high-availability configurations Hands-on experience with network dashboards and platforms such as Cisco Meraki and HPE Aruba Experience implementing and managing VPN and secure access solutions such as Palo Alto Prisma Access, Cloudfare IPSEC L2TP and Cisco secure client / anyconnect Experience with network authentication technologies such as FoxPass, LDAP, and Okta (SAML) Solid understanding of enterprise network design and cloud networking best practices (High availability, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, IP subnetting, firewall rules) Experience partnering with InfoSec, Physical Security, and Workplace teams on cross-functional network initiatives Scripting skills for network automation using infrastructure as code Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences Experience with network documentation such as rack elevation, patching matrices and network topologies at a layer 2 and layer 3 level There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel Preferred Qualifications CCNA, CCNP, Meraki Solutions specialist, or equivalent networking certification Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and hybrid network architectures Experience mentoring other network or systems engineers Familiarity with MDM and endpoint tools such as JAMF and Workspace ONE (AirWatch) Experience working directly with ISPs and external vendors to resolve complex connectivity issues Success Measures In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's network infrastructure and policies, have completed a review of the existing environment, and be providing effective L3 support In 6 months, you will: Have led at least one medium-scale network or VPN project end to end, such as a Palo Alto Prisma Access rollout or office network upgrade, and implemented measurable network security improvements In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as a senior technical owner for MongoDB's global network, having led large-scale infrastructure projects and mentored other engineers on the team Location & Travel: This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and The role covers the full lifecycle of workplace services, including endpoint configuration and security, software packaging and deployment, mobile devices, printing solutions and meeting-room technology. Manage endpoints through Microsoft SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Intune. Configure and support Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID services and Group Policy. Participate in proofs of concept, test campaigns, lifecycle projects and workplace technology rollouts. Coordinate suppliers and internal stakeholders until incidents and service requests reach a clear resolution. Create and maintain technical procedures, operational documentation and end-user guidance. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and continuous service improvement. Experience with endpoint security, software packaging and application deployment. Proven ability to investigate and resolve complex Level 2 and Level 3 incidents autonomously. review_candidates.title: Network & Security Architect (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Wie sieht die Zukunft der Luftfahrt aus? Unser Rocken Partner gestaltet sie aktiv mit. Als etablierter Technologiepartner entwickelt und wartet er hochkomplexe Systeme und Komponenten, die weltweit im Einsatz sind. Präzision, Zuverlässigkeit und Innovation stehen im Zentrum des Handelns. Das Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – von der Entwicklung über die Fertigung bis hin zu umfassenden Wartungs- und Modernisierungslösungen. Dabei werden höchste Qualitätsstandards mit technologischem Fortschritt verbunden. Jedes Projekt trägt dazu bei, Sicherheit und Leistungsfähigkeit auf ein neues Level zu heben. Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein prägen die Zusammenarbeit. Fachliche Exzellenz trifft auf echten Teamgeist. Bereit, an Lösungen zu arbeiten, die wirklich zählen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich mit unserem Rocken Partner zusammenzubringen. Verantwortung Du entwickelst moderne Netzwerk- und Security-Architekturen und überführst technische Anforderungen in belastbare Gesamtlösungen. Du analysierst komplexe Kommunikationsumgebungen und definierst Designs für Routing, Switching, Segmentierung und sichere Plattformanbindungen. Du stimmst technische Konzepte mit Kunden, Entwicklern und weiteren Engineering-Teams ab und vertrittst die gewählte Architektur fachlich. Du baust Prototypen und Testumgebungen auf, führst Machbarkeitsanalysen durch und validierst neue Technologien unter realistischen Bedingungen. Du arbeitest in agilen Teams an Spezifikationen, Tests und automatisierten Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Prozessen mit. Qualifikationen Du hast ein Studium in Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation abgeschlossen. Du bringst tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnologien wie TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, Routing, Switching und Overlay-/Underlay-Netzwerken mit. Du verfügst über gute Linux-Kenntnisse und kannst technische Systeme selbstständig analysieren, testen und in Betrieb nehmen. Du kennst dich mit Architekturmethoden und Modellierung aus und kannst technische Konzepte verständlich dokumentieren und präsentieren. Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch sowie gut auf Englisch. Benefits Attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten Komfortables Büro mit moderner Infrastruktur Interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten/Projekte Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team Gute Verkehrsanbindung und Erreichbarkeit Homeoffice Attraktive Vorsorge- und Versicherungsleistungen Offene Unternehmenskultur ROCKEN Jobs https://rocken.jobs Profil Erstellen https://rocken.jobs/application/profil-erstellen/

review_candidates.title: Senior Subsea Project & Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: Overview Microsoft has made significant first-party investments in submarine network systems around the world to drive industry innovation and meet growing global capacity demands. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in fulfilling our obligations to investment partners, host nations, and end-user customers. To support the continued success of these long-term, strategically important projects, Microsoft is seeking world-class talent to lead and strengthen subsea operations across our portfolio. This role supports submarine cable systems that are critical to Microsoft’s cloud and AI capabilities, enabling services used by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. We are looking for an experienced, courageous, and adaptable professional with strong hands-on experience in submarine cable route design, route engineering, and project implementation who can support, influence, and deliver network infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical, communication, people-management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable business impact. In alignment with Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment where all employees can contribute positively to our culture every day. Responsibilities The Senior Subsea Project and Operations Manager will be responsible for managing, standardizing, and driving steady-state execution across key areas of Microsoft’s subsea investment portfolio. This role carries deep responsibility for submarine cable projects and operations across multiple systems. Partner with Microsoft network investment and commercial managers to bring an operator-focused perspective to submarine consortium and joint-investment engagements on a system-by-system basis. Act as an active and key contributor in consortium and committee meetings, particularly CCM, IPG, MWG, and TWG, to effectively represent Microsoft’s needs and interests. Lead and support successful submarine cable project implementation, with particular focus on cable route design, route planning, desktop study review, route engineering, marine survey coordination, permitting/interface considerations, and implementation risk management across complex marine environments. Develop long-term partnership strategies with key vendors and industry peers, including bringing parties together for submarine cable projects and supporting negotiations for ITTs, JBAs/C&MAs, supply contracts, and non-supply contracts. Plan, communicate, represent, and secure ongoing annual funding required to meet and exceed Microsoft’s system obligations, including responsibilities where Microsoft serves as Maintenance Authority. Ensure billing milestones and payments are met predictably through effective long-range and detailed budgeting across supply and non-supply contracts, with strong engagement across Microsoft Finance and Tax teams. Plan, communicate, and execute against budgets for system upgrade plans. Work closely with procurement organizations to plan annual purchase orders, execute contracts as required, and maintain a predictable business rhythm. Serve as the escalation point and remediation expert for matters related to Microsoft-owned cable systems, cable landing station infrastructure, access-related works, Network Operations Centers, and data center interfaces across multiple systems. Collaborate closely with Security, Facilities Management, external service providers, and vendors to support operational continuity and issue resolution. Partner with global Microsoft Legal teams to ensure contract clarity, integrity, and compliance in each country of operation or obligation. Clearly communicate Microsoft’s contracted year-over-year obligations to CO+I executive leadership, including executive briefings on system status, health, cost reviews, and partner relationships. Develop and maintain internal repositories to ensure secure access to information related to all aspects of Microsoft’s involvement in contracted subsea programs. Represent Microsoft and/or specific systems externally with environmental groups and third-party industry committees where close cooperation is required to protect and sustain system health. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, communications infrastructure, or a related discipline. Strong executive communication, organizational, and presentation skills. Executive-level budgeting capability and strong financial acumen. Demonstrated contract-management skills, including contractual risk assessment, priority evaluation, and obligation management. Minimum 5+ years of extensive hands-on experience in submarine cable route design, route planning, route engineering, route development, marine survey interpretation, and related implementation activities across complex subsea cable projects. Minimum 5+ years of proven experience and deep understanding across one or more major subsea cable systems as a first-party owner, including: Project planning and implementation Submarine cable engineering Operations and maintenance Terrestrial fiber optics Experience with networks, optical line systems, and related technologies within carrier, cloud/AI, big-tech, or OEM environments. 2+ years of proven experience managing backhaul access planning, programs, and relationships across U.S. and global environments. Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different time zones. Demonstrated command of existing subsea systems topologies, cable landings and Top Interconnection facilities regionally In-depth knowledge of performance metrics Excellent communication and leadership skills Organizational and time-management skills Decision-making skills 7+ years of experience in marine cable engineering, project planning, and implementation, preferably with significant exposure to submarine cable route design from early feasibility through construction and ready-for-service delivery. 3+ years of daily operational experience with submarine cable systems, with a solid working understanding of domestic and global carrier networks. 3+ years of experience in network, data center, colocation sourcing, acquisition, and contracting. Strong problem-solving, strategic-thinking, and technical skills. Demonstrated business acumen through prior work experience or education. Self-driven, with the ability to work effectively with minimal direction. Experience using a data-driven and metrics-driven approach, with the ability to experiment, learn, and continuously improve. Familiarity with service catalog and workflow methodologies. Previous direct experience working with a telecom provider and/or OTT subsea team. Experience working with telecom and subsea providers. Previous experience working with Microsoft telecom and network capacity planning teams. Strong analysis and problem-solving skills Willing to travel between 25% and 50% of the time Background Check Requirements Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. #COICareers | #EPCCareers | #DCDCareers This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. review_candidates.description: Organizational Context The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian network, with 191-member National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. IFRC uses the Triple R – response, resilience and respect – to deliver on Strategy 2030. IFRC responds to disasters and crises, ensuring timely, coordinated and locally led humanitarian action. IFRC supports its members in building community resilience in the areas of climate and environment, health and wellbeing, and migration and displacement. IFRC promotes respect for our fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality, including in our work on values, power and inclusion. The IFRC focuses throughout on our core mandate – our raison d’être – of strategic and operational coordination, humanitarian diplomacy, National Society development, and accountability. IFRC is led by its Secretary General and has its Headquarters in Geneva and five regional offices in Africa (Nairobi); the Americas (Panama); Asia Pacific (Kuala Lumpur); Europe (Budapest); and MENA (Beirut) as well as representation offices, service centres and delegations across the globe. The IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles. IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. The Headquarters are organized into three main Divisions: (i) National Society Development and Operations Coordination; (ii) Global Relations, Humanitarian Diplomacy and Digitalization; and (iii) Management Policy, Strategy and Corporate Services.IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegation and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat. The IFRC Kinshasa Delegation covers four countries: the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, the Republic of Congo, and Rwanda. The Delegation supports National Red Cross Societies across a complex, multi-country context characterized by recurrent shocks, cross-border risks, and diverse humanitarian programmes including disaster risk management, anticipatory action, epidemics response through in kind or cash modalities. Within the Country Delegation, the Programmes and Operations Department is responsible for ensuring the effective design, implementation, monitoring, financial stewardship and reporting of programmes and operations funded through a variety of donors and funding mechanisms. The Senior Officer, Project Performance support serves as the focal point for project quality assurance and performance management. The position provides leadership and coordination of programme finance, planning, monitoring, evaluation, reporting and accountability processes to ensure projects are designed, implemented and reported in compliance with IFRC standards and donor requirements. The incumbent manages a multidisciplinary team covering Programme Finance and PMER functions and may progressively assume supervision of Information Management capacities. The position ensures effective integration of programme finance, planning, monitoring, evaluation, reporting and learning processes throughout the project cycle. The role supports programme and operations teams in project design, budget development, implementation monitoring, donor compliance, financial performance management, results measurement and reporting. The incumbent leads a multidisciplinary team and promotes a culture of quality, accountability, evidence-based management and continuous improvement to maximize programme impact and donor confidence. Ensure consistency between programme and operations objectives, budgets, indicators, workplans and donor commitments. Support project managers during project design, inception, implementation, review and closure in order to standardize and improve process, implementation and reporting. Facilitate regular project performance reviews and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Strengthen coordination between Programmes, Operations, Finance, PMER and other support functions. Project Finance Management Support Support project budget development, revisions and donor proposal costing. Support the monitoring of budget utilization, spending trends, burn rates and funding gaps. Ensure financial performance is regularly analyzed and shared with project managers. Support donor financial reporting and ensure compliance with donor regulations and IFRC policies. Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation actions. Coordinate follow-up of audit findings and compliance recommendations. Support project close-out and financial reconciliation processes. Coordinate closely with finance department to ensure compliance and transparent control Planning, Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting (PMER) Ensure quality planning, monitoring, evaluation and reporting systems are established across all projects. Oversee development and implementation of monitoring plans and performance frameworks. Ensure projects utilize SMART indicators and appropriate data collection methodologies. Support the design and implementation of evaluations, reviews and lessons learned exercises. Promote use of monitoring data for programmes and operations improvement and management decision-making. Ensure timely and high-quality donor, operational and management reporting. Facilitate dissemination of evidence, evaluation findings and lessons learned across the delegation and National Society Performance Management, Learning and Accountability Establish systems to track project performance, risks, compliance and results achievement. Promote accountability to affected populations and integration of feedback mechanisms. Support programmes and operations teams in analyzing performance trends and identifying improvement opportunities. Lead portfolio performance reviews and facilitate action planning. Promote organizational learning and knowledge management. Ensure lessons learned are documented and integrated into future programming. Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued) Information Management and Data Quality Ensure project information and performance data are managed effectively and consistently. Promote data quality assurance processes and information management standards. Support development of project dashboards, tracking tools and performance reporting systems. Facilitate availability of accurate and timely information for operational and strategic decision-making. Supervise Information Management functions where applicable. Team Leadership and Capacity Strengthening Line manage and support Programmes and Operations Finance and PMER staff. Establish team objectives and monitor performance. Foster collaboration between technical functions supporting project delivery. Identify capacity gaps and coordinate mentoring, coaching and training initiatives. Strengthening project management, financial project management and PMER capacities within the delegation and National Society. Contribute to the development and rollout of tools, guidance and standard operating procedures. Development of National Societies Support, as necessary, capacity building and development of National Member Societies in areas of expertise (e.g. PMER, IM, budget management, project management). Education Required University degree in Finance, Project Management, Business Administration, Economics, Monitoring & Evaluation, International Development or related field. Preferred Professional certification in project management, monitoring and evaluation and/or finance. Experience Required Minimum 7 years of progressively responsible experience in humanitarian or development programmes. Experience supporting proposal development, project implementation and reporting Experience supervising staff or multidisciplinary teams. Experience managing donor-funded projects and grants. Experience in emergency operations Preferred Experience in both project finance and PMER/project performance functions Experience within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement Experience managing Information Management functions Knowledge, Skills and Languages Required Strong understanding of project cycle management. Strong knowledge of financial management and donor compliance Strong PMER and results-based management expertise Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Strong report writing and communication skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex environment Advanced Excel and data analysis skills Demonstrated core proficiency in (a) digital communication & collaboration, (b) basic digital content creation, (c) digital safety & security, (d) data literacy, and (e) problem solving with technology (including responsible use of AI assistants Understanding of and commitment to IFRC’s mission and values Fluently spoken and written in French and English Preferred Knowledge of IFRC systems and procedures Experience with ERP systems and project management platforms Data visualization and dashboard development skills Good command of another IFRC official language (French, Spanish or Arabic) Competencies, Values and Comments Values: Respect for diversity; Integrity; Professionalism; Accountability Core competencies: Communication; Collaboration and teamwork; Judgement and decision making; National society and customer relations; Creativity and innovation; Building

[담당 업무] 국내 및 글로벌 비지니스(중국 및 글로벌 수출건 핸들링, 3국 무역 등)의 제품 공급을 위한 소싱 업무를 담당합니다. 원가관리(COSTING, NEGO)를 담당합니다. 기준 원/부자재 구성요소 분석 및 단가 협의 주요 부자재(지퍼, 단추, 안감, 충전재 등)의 사양별 단가 관리 및 규모에 따른 단가 협상 원/부자재 및 세부 원가 항목을 포함한 총 원가 구조 설계 의류 생산, 공급망 관리 업무를 수행합니다. 시즌별 생산 전략 수립 및 오더 플래닝 협력사 및 공장과의 납기, 리드타임 관리 및 생산 일정 조율 공급망 리스크 대응을 위한 전략 수립 및 실행 국내/해외 신규 거래처 소싱, 공장 소싱, 원부자재 소싱을 담당합니다. 중국/베트남/인도네시아/미얀마 등 글로벌 생산 벤더 발굴 및 성과 관리 우븐, 니트, 다운 등 제품별 특화된 공장 소싱 및 정량/정성평가 장기 관점의 전략적 파트너십 구축 진행 주요 부자재(지퍼, 충전재, 안감 등) 개발 및 소싱 KS 및 GB TEST를 포함하여, 제품과 원부자재의 전반적인 품질 관리를 수행합니다. 글로벌 비즈니스 대응을 위한 원부자재 퀄리티 및 TEST 기준 관리 기능성 원/부자재 TEST 및 사전 관리 품질 이슈 공유/관리 및 후속 조치, 다양한 생산 이슈 사전 방지 [자격 요건] 4년제 대졸 이상의 학력을 보유하신 분 관련 업무 7년 이상의 경력 또는 그에 준하는 역량을 보유하고 계신 분 비즈니스 영어(메일, 회화 및 업무 소통)가 능숙하신 분 GLOBAL SOURCING & DIRECT SOURCING (garment, fabric, trim 등) 경험이 있으신 분 무역 업무의 이해도가 높으며, 직수입 FOB 및 다양한 incoterms (결제 방식 L/C, T/T 등) 업무가 가능하신 분 의류 생산 프로세스, 원가 구조, 납기 운영, 품질관리 등 End-to-End 프로세스의 높은 이해도를 가지고 계신 분 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없으신 분 [우대 사항] 의류 관련학과(섬유공학, 의류/의상, 디자인 등)를 전공하신 분 내수와 수출 비즈니스를 모두 경험해보신 분 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 능력으로 유관부서 및 협력사와 원활하게 소통하며 최고의 성과를 만드실 수 있으신 분 데이터 분석 도구에 익숙하며, 데이터를 기반으로 효율적인 소싱 전략을 수립하고 성과를 측정하실 수 있으신 분 외국어 능력(영어/베트남어/중국어 등)이 우수하고 글로벌 각지의 소싱처와 자유롭게 소통하고 새로운 정보나 기술을 적극적으로 수용해서 업무에 적용할 수 있으신 분 [근무조건] 정규직 [지원서류] 이력서(필수) / 포트폴리오(선택) (참고) 이력서/포트폴리오 작성 팁 이력서/포트폴리오에는 왜 해당 문제를 해결해야 했는지, 어떤 전략을 세웠는지, 어떤 성과가 있었는지 등에 대한 문제 정의, 문제 해결, 성과에 대한 전반적인 내용을 담아주세요. 프로젝트의 성공과 실패를 떠나, 1차 면접에서 인터뷰어와 심도있는 이야기를 나눌 수 있도록 프로젝트의 이해도가 높은 이력서로 구성해주세요. (프로젝트별 기여도 표시) [전형절차] 접수 기간 : 상시지원 전형 절차 : 서류 전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 - 처우 협의 - 최종합격 문의 사항 : [email protected] [기타사항] 본 포지션은 수시 진행으로 우수 인재 채용 시 마감될 수 있습니다. 적합한 지원자에게 채용 담당자가 개별 연락 예정이며, 내부 규정에 따라 각 전형 단계별 개별 피드백은 제공하지 않습니다. 최종 합격자는 3개월간의 수습기간이 적용되며, 해당 기간 중 급여는 100% 지급됩니다. 입사지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

review_candidates.title: Senior Support Representative (APAC／JST)
review_candidates.description: About Intento Founded in 2016, Intento has grown alongside the AI and language technology industry itself — from early machine translation, through the rise of LLMs, to the AI agents we build today. Throughout that shift, the problem we're solving hasn't changed: letting companies speak authentically to every customer and employee, in every language. What's changed is our ability to solve it well. We've built this fully remotely, with a diverse team spread across the world, held together by a culture of teamwork, ownership, and trust. And because the technology we work with keeps moving, so do we — we don't hold onto an approach just because it used to work. When something changes in the landscape, or in what our customers need, we adjust fast and keep building. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an experienced Senior Support Representative to independently own our support coverage during APAC/JST business hours — the sole point of contact for our customers during this shift, inside a 24/7, follow-the-sun rotation alongside our Europe- and Americas-based teams. This is a senior, largely autonomous role for someone who's already operating at a Senior Tier-1 or Tier-2 level: you'll resolve escalated technical issues and manage enterprise-grade customer relationships independently, without a second line to lean on during your hours. Because of that, we're specifically looking for people who already have hands-on experience supporting large enterprise clients at a B2B SaaS company, and who've personally investigated and owned escalations end-to-end, rather than following someone else's playbook. This is a customer-facing role — you'll be working directly with Intento's external clients, rather than providing internal IT/helpdesk support to colleagues within a single company. This role is open to candidates based in APAC time zones able to own a full business day inside the 00:00–09:00 UTC window. WE ARE LOOKING FOR Hard skills: - 3+ years, hands-on, in Tier-2 / 2nd-line technical support at a B2B SaaS company, supporting that company's external, paying customers (ideally large-enterprise clients) - A track record of independently investigating and resolving escalated technical issues (bug reproduction, root-cause analysis) - Experience personally managing high-stakes enterprise escalations, including difficult or upset stakeholders - Fluent written and spoken English - Working knowledge of HTML, RESTful APIs, and debugging/troubleshooting fundamentals Soft skills: - High emotional intelligence — you know when to listen, when to explain, and how to de-escalate - Strong bias toward ownership: you see issues through to resolution, not just first response - Comfortable being the only person online for your region and shift - Clear, confident, and empathetic communicator, especially under pressure Preferred / Nice to have: - Localization, translation-technology, or software-integration background - Prior experience as the sole/remote support coverage for a region or shift - Familiarity with Zendesk, Plain, Intercom, Jira/Linear, Confluence, or comparable tools RESPONSIBILITIES - Own end-to-end resolution of escalated (Tier-2) and first-line tickets during the APAC/JST shift - Investigate and resolve complex technical issues using a structured, reproducible troubleshooting methodology - Manage and de-escalate high-stakes conversations with large-enterprise accounts - Escalate to Development/Product only after independent investigation, with findings attached - Build and maintain Knowledge Base content for recurring regional issues - Coordinate clean handoffs with the Europe- and Americas-based support teams Why Intento? At Intento, we're solving a problem that looks simple from the outside and isn't: getting AI to translate not just fluently, but correctly — matching a company's own terminology, tone, and compliance requirements. It's a harder, more interesting engineering and product problem than most AI applications get to work on, and it's why global enterprises like Indeed, Hexagon, Strava, Agilent, and Playrix trust us instead of building it in-house. We're a multicultural team working remotely from different parts of the world, with a culture built around flexibility, transparency, and ownership. We offer competitive compensation and an environment where people are trusted to do their best work. Join a fast-paced environment where you can directly shape the course of the company. Get real transparency into business strategy and decisions — you'll understand the big picture and your impact on it. Enjoy a balance of autonomy and responsibility: make decisions and own outcomes. Work on a genuinely hard problem — enterprise-grade translation quality — alongside people who've thought deeply about it. Get hands-on experience deploying AI systems into production for large global companies. Work alongside a talented team — engineering, linguistic, operational, and beyond — who care about doing the job well and supporting each other.

review_candidates.description: ARIS is a Process Intelligence company that helps organizations discover, create, and transform their processes to deliver measurable business outcomes and scale AI with confidence. It combines process design, real execution insight, and AI-driven optimization in a single, integrated platform-enabling organizations to build a governed digital twin of their operations, understand how work actually happens, and continuously deliver value across the enterprise. By providing the process foundation, visibility, and governance required for AI adoption, ARIS enables businesses to deploy and scale Agentic AI safely and effectively, ensuring agents operate on trusted processes, data, and controls. With over 30 years of expertise and recognition from leading analysts such as Gartner and Forrester, ARIS is trusted by global enterprises to turn process intelligence into real business impact. For more information, visit www.ARIS.com and follow us on LinkedIn. Be you, join us. We are currently seeking a Senior Solution Architect (PreSales) to join our team in Saudi Arabia . As a Solution Architect in our presales team, you will be responsible for supporting and managing strategic ARIS opportunities in the MENA region. Essential Functions Acting as a passionate advocate for Business Process Management (BPM). Leading and supporting cross-functional teams throughout the customer buying journey. Engaging in C-level discussions to articulate the value and benefits of our solutions and BPM strategies. Serving as a trusted advisor to customers, providing expert guidance on BPM best practices and solution implementation. Delivering compelling presentations and demonstrations of our tool's capabilities. Addressing customer inquiries and responding to RFPs and RFIs with precision. Delivering high-quality Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proof of Value (PoV) projects. Developing industry-specific or use case-specific showcases to highlight solution effectiveness. Collaborating with product and development teams to align customer feedback with product enhancements. Staying updated on industry trends and competitive landscape to position our BPM solution effectively. Mentoring and training junior team members on BPM best practices and solution delivery. Contributing to the development of sales strategies and go-to-market plans. Participating in industry events, webinars, and conferences to promote our BPM solutions and gather market insights. Minimum Requirements 10+ years of experience in presales. Proven ability to effectively present technology solutions to executive-level stakeholders, with a focus on value-driven selling and business impact. Hands-on experience with ARIS or similar BPM tools, with the ability to demonstrate and configure these platforms. Strong technical acumen to address customer inquiries on topics such as product architecture, security, and integration. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly understand customer challenges and propose effective BPM solutions. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with both internal teams and external clients. Ability to stay current with the latest BPM trends, tools, and methodologies, and apply this knowledge to drive continuous improvement and innovation in customer solutions. Business fluent in English. Nice to Haves Experience as a BPM practitioner in roles such as presales or consulting. Experience with BPM disciplines such as Process Modeling, Process Mining, Simulation, Process Governance, Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, and related methodologies. You have experience with using or even implementing ARIS (absolute plus) or a similarly mature product. You have been part of key transformation, operational excellence, compliance or risk management projects as a consultant and subject matter expert or as a project manager or as both. Benefits Comprehensive private medical insurance (Cigna) for you and eligible dependents — inpatient, outpatient, maternity, dental, vision and mental health cover, with pre-existing conditions covered from day one Prescription drugs covered in and outside the Kingdom, no co-pay Group life insurance (Zurich), plus Accidental Death & Disability cover, from day one Global Rescue membership — 24/7 medical, travel and security assistance anywhere in the world International Employee Assistance Programme — 24/7 counselling, in person and by phone Company laptop and mobile Work authorization & relocation Please note that visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based without requiring employer sponsorship. review_candidates.title: Reliability & Asset Management Senior Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation
review_candidates.description: At First Quantum, we free the talent of our people by taking a very different approach which is underpinned by a very different, very definite culture – the “First Quantum Way”. Working with us is not like working anywhere else, which is why we recruit people who will take a bolder, smarter approach to spot opportunities, solve problems and deliver results. Our culture is all about encouraging you to think independently and to challenge convention to deliver the best result. That’s how we continue to achieve extraordinary things in extraordinary locations. Job Description Asset Management Support the implementation and maintenance of the Smelter Asset Management Framework and associated standards for the fixed plant and mobile equipment assets. Develop and maintain accurate asset registers and equipment hierarchies in Pronto. Monitor asset health indicators and identify deterioration trends requiring maintenance intervention. Manage the strategy, governance, and optimization of the reliability maintenance initiatives to prevent related mechanical failures. Build and maintain asset health indices combining equipment age, thickness test data, and operating history to predict remaining useful life. Carry out periodic asset condition assessments and asset health reviews. Assist with equipment risk assessments and identification of mitigation measures. Support the rollout and implementation of the digital maintenance platforms such as the OnPlan platform. Reliability and Performance Monitoring Monitor the reliability of HV/LV systems, MCCs, transformers, PLC, DCS, SCADA and field instrumentation through KPI tracking and data analysis. Monitor asset health indicators and performance metrics to identify reliability risks and improvement opportunities for smelter E&I equipment. Per te, rappresenta la grande opportunità di entrare a far parte di una solida multinazionale dove formarti e sviluppare la tua carriera in un settore in crescita e in un ambiente giovane, innovativo e super stimolante. Scoprire nuovi orizzonti, crescere in una realtà dinamica, condividere la passione per i brand. Per te abbiamo un ruolo da Merchandiser Allestitore: l’inizio di una carriera nel mondo del field marketing. Non sarai solo ma sempre in contatto con altri colleghi, i professionisti del punto vendita e in costante dialogo con la sede CPM di Milano. Requisiti Sei tu la persona giusta? Non servono competenze specifiche ma è fondamentale l’attitudine alla relazione, la voglia di comunicare e di entrare in sintonia con le persone. Coordinate suppliers and internal stakeholders until incidents and service requests reach a clear resolution. Guided by a mission to make food accessible everywhere and a vision to connect people and communities to healthy food anywhere, YooKatale focuses strongly on customer needs and satisfaction. The company’s core values emphasize customer focus, respect, simplicity, authenticity, curiosity, valuing opportunities, and perseverance. YooKatale operates as a hybrid organization, integrating physical and digital solutions to address everyday societal challenges. Its culture follows a customer-first, employee-second, stakeholder-third approach, aligning efforts toward delivering value to customers while fostering a positive work environment and sustainable stakeholder relationships. Role Description The Investor role at YooKatale is a hybrid position based in Dubai, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role involves evaluating and financing strategic initiatives that expand YooKatale’s mobile food market presence and enhance food accessibility across target regions. The Investor will review business plans, financial models, and market analyses to assess investment opportunities and risks, and will collaborate with leadership to shape growth strategies and capital allocation. Day-to-day activities include monitoring portfolio performance, participating in strategic meetings, providing input on fundraising and partnerships, and ensuring investments align with YooKatale’s mission and values. The role also requires building relationships with co-investors, advisors, and partners to support long-term, sustainable growth. Qualifications Strong financial analysis and investment evaluation skills, including experience with financial modeling, budgeting, and ROI assessment. Background in venture capital, private equity, corporate finance, or impact investing, ideally within technology, food, or emerging markets. Ability to conduct market research and due diligence, interpret data, and make evidence-based investment recommendations. Strategic thinking and business development capabilities, with experience supporting growth initiatives or scaling early-stage ventures. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across diverse, cross-cultural teams. Demonstrated interest in food accessibility, social impact, or purpose-driven enterprises, aligned with YooKatale’s mission and values. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage. Comfort working in a hybrid setup based in Dubai, with flexibility to attend in-person meetings and collaborate across time zones.

new_matches.title: Fuels Manager/Alternate Site Manager
new_matches.description: The Fuels Manager (FM)/Alternate Site Manager (ASM) provides leadership and guidance to FUELS Department personnel. Responsible for the overall program management of FUELS assets. Manages asset receipts, accountability, serviceability, storage, security, periodic inspections and deployment. Establishes asset reconstitution production schedules to meet United States Air Forces Central (USAFCENT) requirements. Reviews asset reconstitution production, periodic maintenance, and inventory reports to ensure timely and accurate submissions to USAFCENT A4/RF. Provides guidance on environmental issues as they relate to fuel assets. Responsible for program quality assurance as part of ISO 9000 standards. The ASM portion of the position coordinates and oversees the day-to-day operations, maintenance, personnel, and services at assigned location ensuring quality to the customer as directed by Site Manager. Job Duties & Responsibilities Primary liaison between Amentum sites and USAFCENT on issues pertaining to FUELS. Oversees reconstitution and preservation plan for FUELS based upon requirements and the Performance Work Statement (PWS), to include the calibration of meters, gauges and tools, functional testing of pumping systems and hydrostatic testing of fuel hoses. Tracks FUELS deployments, ensuring timely delivery of assets. Answers inquiries from Program Management and sites concerning various requests from the USAF and external agencies. Attends staff meetings and provides management reports and briefings, as required. Provides assistance, guidance and coordination on revisions of FUELS maintenance actions in response to changes in Air Force Publications, Technical Orders and the PWS. Oversees Product Quality Deficiency Reports from submission to resolution. Creates, coordinates, implements, and revises FUELS Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions and Training Plans, as required. Conducts periodic staff assistance visits to all sites. Performs other duties and TDY travel as directed by management. Performs duties of Site Manager in Site Manager’s absence. Manages basic support services and accompanying labor force for assigned location. Manages small team of U.S. nationals supervising skilled, semi-skilled foreign and local nationals. Ensure that all requirements are met as defined in the Performance Work Statement. Communicate new requirements, concerns, and issues to PMO for resolution. Ensure that requirements are met for employee health, morale, and welfare. Ensure that employees adhere to the Armed Forces and host nation standards of conduct concerning in-theater operations. Effectively manage any employee management issues that may arise. Closely supervises equipment and material within assigned area of responsibility. Closely supervises the arrival, retrofit, and upgrade of equipment and material as assigned. Conducts the weekly and monthly collection of data for quality input to PEBs or AFEB. Submits timely reports required by the United States Government. Conducts regular property inventories. Perform other duties as assigned. Management Responsibility Provides functional management for FUELS issues program wide. Manages day-to-day operations as assigned by Site Manager. Performs Site Manager duties in Site Manager’s absence. Knowledge & Skills Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing. Capable of organizing data quickly and effectively. Able to prepare and execute briefings. Knowledge of the USAF maintenance management system, to include OLVIMS required. Knowledge of the maintenance and operating procedures for Fuels Operational Readiness Capability Equipment (FORCE) desired. Knowledge of FUELS industrial safety, quality, environmental procedures, material deficiency reporting and the USAF supply system required. Proficiency in Microsoft software applications required, particularly MS Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc. Shall be knowledgeable and supervise all aspects of assignment of qualified personnel, scheduling workload, developing programs and procedures to satisfy customer requirements, coordinating with on-base support, preparing official correspondence, evaluating improvement suggestions, and knowledge of chain of command and protocol. Compliance with fire, safety, and environmental protection requirements. Background displaying ability to staff, organize, lead and manage a diverse work force larger than 5 people, particularly Foreign Nationals (FNs). Willingness to travel and work in various locations in the world. Willingness to work shifts and extended hours in support of 24/7 operations. Willingness to learn about the cultural, economic, geopolitical, and/or military issues of the Middle East and/or Arab-speaking countries within that region desired. Ability to exercise discretion and make effective decisions. Solid communications skills, strong interpersonal skills. Strong ability to work as a member of a diverse, dynamic team. Outstanding problem-solving skills and sound judgment. Must be capable of obtaining a flight line driver license when required by COR. Must be capable of obtaining HAZMAT certifications as required by the PWS and/or host nation. Experience & Education The Fuels Manager shall have a minimum of six (6) years of specialized experience in fuels hydrant operations and maintenance of bulk petroleum storage terminals. The FM/ASM shall have a minimum of three (3) years of experience in logistics, project management, operations management or facilities management/maintenance field. As a minimum, the Fuels OM&R Manager shall have two (2) years of supervisory experience in fuel hydrants operations with emphasis in operations and environmental compliance. Must be able to obtain and maintain a SECRET US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a SECRET Clearance. Must have a High School Diploma or equivalent. Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Physical Requirements/Working Environment Works in normal office environment and as required outside and/or in fuel facilities. Living and working conditions at the assignment location could be remote and uncomfortable. Long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions. Personnel should be aware of moving on short notice and under adverse conditions. Travel /Other Ability to travel domestically and internationally. Other Responsibilities Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks, and serving on safety committees and teams. Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities. Procedure Compliance - Each employee must read, understand, and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to job.

new_matches.title: Civil Project Engineer
new_matches.description: Company Description: TSI Engineering Inc (TSI) is a USA-based design-build commercial and heavy civil engineering construction company. TSI's corporate office is located in California, USA. We are looking for a qualified engineer who can work in our Faisalabad (Pakistan) office. Working hours will be 8:00 pm – 5:00 am (Pakistan Standard Time). Email your resume to mubashar@tsi3.com. Role Description: Prepare cost estimates, technical and cost proposals, and bid documents in a timely manner for commercial and heavy civil engineering construction projects. Must have excellent English speaking skills to make phone calls and communicate with vendors and subcontractors based in the USA. Prepare RFQ (Request for Quote) and contact vendors/subcontractors in proposed project areas to obtain quotes and identify qualified subcontractors/vendors. Read and understand construction drawings and specifications to prepare a bill of quantities, take offs and cost estimate. Understand contractual terms and familiar with US Federal (FAR Acquisitions Clauses) and State contracting clauses. Evaluate and negotiate quotes to make sure quotes meet the project requirements and prepare purchase orders. Prepare project schedule (PrimaVera P6 and MS Project), perform construction procurements to ensure the availability of construction material at the site before starting any construction activity. Identify any potential risks. Coordinate with the site project manager to ensure site personnel are provided with proper documentation and prepare a monthly and week ahead schedule. Prepare construction submittals, Construction Quality Control (CQC), Health & Safety Plan, and maintain submittal logs. Maintain relationships with sub-contractors and clients. Formulate a cost breakdown from the estimate, analyze labor, material, equipment, and time requirements for a project. Estimator Construction Skills and Qualifications: Minimum B.Sc in Civil Engineering, M.S in Construction Management shall be preferred. Minimum 3 years of experience in Project Estimation, preferably for the US construction industry, similar or related position. Previous experience in estimating multi-million projects. Experience with estimating software and spreadsheet design, and ability to use CAD programs. Working knowledge of construction costs and principles. Must be detail-oriented. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills. Estimating experience (quantity takeoffs, purchasing accounting, engineering design knowledge, and project management experience desirable) Knowledge of how to use complex project management software and construction scheduling software, such as PrimaVera P6, is preferred. Salary: A Comparative Pakistan market attractive salary.

new_matches.title: Aftercare Internships and Fellowships - June 2027 Field Office Deployment
new_matches.description: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve. The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking Aftercare Interns & Fellows. Aftercare Interns and Fellows support our national staff with programming for a variety of casework types (i.e., Human Trafficking, Bonded Labor, Child Sexual Assault, Intimate Partner Violence, etc.) as we seek restoration and rehabilitation for our clients. IJM's Internship and Fellowship opportunities vary every session and look different in every office. Depending on your level of experience, your role may involve some of the following responsibilities as well as other relevant duties assigned by the Field Office Director or Supervisor. In collaboration with IJM Global Aftercare and the Director of Aftercare, assist in the continued development of a comprehensive aftercare strategy for IJM; Support casework information management and input case details into Casework Tracking Management System; Maintain up-to-date statistics and information for the department; Assist in the development of systems and processes for the respective Aftercare teams as needed; Conduct research and impact assessments on how IJM Aftercare interventions affect IJM clients; Develop and maintain partnerships with aftercare providers, under the direction and guidance of the Director of Aftercare; In collaboration with IJM Global Aftercare and the Director of Aftercare, draft best practices for rehabilitation and reintegration of IJM clients; Travel with IJM staff to meet with IJM clients and work with area leaders (Please note: not every office will require or permit interns or fellows to have direct client interaction); Complete professional writing assignments including grant proposals, program proposals, and program update reports; Provide support, logistical and/or administrative assistance to IJM Aftercare staff, under the direction of the Director of Aftercare. Other departmental support as needed. Positions may be available in: Accra, Ghana; Bucharest, Romania; Lima, Peru; Guatemala City, Guatemala; San Salvador, El Salvador; Phnom Penh, Cambodia; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Jakarta, Indonesia; Bangkok, Thailand; Manila, Philippines. Not every position will be available in every office. Program duration is 12 months, from June 2027 – May 2028. Internship General Qualifications And Required Skills Bachelor's degree; At least one prior professional internship experience or significant leadership experience in extracurricular, campus, volunteer, or community-based organizations. Organizational and administrative skills; Attention to detail; Knowledge of Microsoft software and Windows strongly preferred; and Fluency in Spanish required for Latin America offices. Fellowship General Qualifications And Required Skills Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) and/or at least three years of relevant experience. Experience or exposure to program design and development; Training or experience in trauma counseling preferred; Experience addressing poverty and livelihood issues; and Fluency in Spanish required for Latin American offices. Critical Qualities Mature orthodox Christian faith; Humble and resilient; Pursues excellence; Culturally aware and appreciative of difference; Strong service ethic; Innovative problem solver; Ability to build trust and strong partnerships with others; Courageous in pursuing opportunities and challenges; Tenacious in achieving goals; and Professional. As volunteers, interns and fellows receive a monthly stipend to help defray their expenses related to participating in the internship program. This volunteer stipend is not an hourly wage, nor wages paid for services provided by the intern or fellow. Application Process: Upload Resume, Cover Letter & Statement of Faith* in one PDF document. What is a statement of faith? A statement of faith should describe your Christian faith and how you see it as relevant to your involvement with IJM. The statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship. IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidate’s value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes. At IJM, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce through fair and equitable employment practices. IJM encourages people of any race, color, age, sex, marital status or political ideology to apply for employment. While we welcome everyone into this work, we truly believe that the work we are doing is God’s work, not our own, and practice spiritual disciplines together daily. That’s why we legally require under SEC. 2000e-1 [Section702] of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 that all employees practice a mature orthodox Christian faith, as defined by the Apostles’ Creed. IJM requires a background check, police clearance and thorough review of references with an employment offer and/or employment contract.

new_matches.title: Senior Support Representative (APAC／JST)
new_matches.description: About Intento Founded in 2016, Intento has grown alongside the AI and language technology industry itself — from early machine translation, through the rise of LLMs, to the AI agents we build today. Throughout that shift, the problem we're solving hasn't changed: letting companies speak authentically to every customer and employee, in every language. What's changed is our ability to solve it well. We've built this fully remotely, with a diverse team spread across the world, held together by a culture of teamwork, ownership, and trust. And because the technology we work with keeps moving, so do we — we don't hold onto an approach just because it used to work. When something changes in the landscape, or in what our customers need, we adjust fast and keep building. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an experienced Senior Support Representative to independently own our support coverage during APAC/JST business hours — the sole point of contact for our customers during this shift, inside a 24/7, follow-the-sun rotation alongside our Europe- and Americas-based teams. This is a senior, largely autonomous role for someone who's already operating at a Senior Tier-1 or Tier-2 level: you'll resolve escalated technical issues and manage enterprise-grade customer relationships independently, without a second line to lean on during your hours. Because of that, we're specifically looking for people who already have hands-on experience supporting large enterprise clients at a B2B SaaS company, and who've personally investigated and owned escalations end-to-end, rather than following someone else's playbook. This is a customer-facing role — you'll be working directly with Intento's external clients, rather than providing internal IT/helpdesk support to colleagues within a single company. This role is open to candidates based in APAC time zones able to own a full business day inside the 00:00–09:00 UTC window. WE ARE LOOKING FOR Hard skills: - 3+ years, hands-on, in Tier-2 / 2nd-line technical support at a B2B SaaS company, supporting that company's external, paying customers (ideally large-enterprise clients) - A track record of independently investigating and resolving escalated technical issues (bug reproduction, root-cause analysis) - Experience personally managing high-stakes enterprise escalations, including difficult or upset stakeholders - Fluent written and spoken English - Working knowledge of HTML, RESTful APIs, and debugging/troubleshooting fundamentals Soft skills: - High emotional intelligence — you know when to listen, when to explain, and how to de-escalate - Strong bias toward ownership: you see issues through to resolution, not just first response - Comfortable being the only person online for your region and shift - Clear, confident, and empathetic communicator, especially under pressure Preferred / Nice to have: - Localization, translation-technology, or software-integration background - Prior experience as the sole/remote support coverage for a region or shift - Familiarity with Zendesk, Plain, Intercom, Jira/Linear, Confluence, or comparable tools RESPONSIBILITIES - Own end-to-end resolution of escalated (Tier-2) and first-line tickets during the APAC/JST shift - Investigate and resolve complex technical issues using a structured, reproducible troubleshooting methodology - Manage and de-escalate high-stakes conversations with large-enterprise accounts - Escalate to Development/Product only after independent investigation, with findings attached - Build and maintain Knowledge Base content for recurring regional issues - Coordinate clean handoffs with the Europe- and Americas-based support teams Why Intento? At Intento, we're solving a problem that looks simple from the outside and isn't: getting AI to translate not just fluently, but correctly — matching a company's own terminology, tone, and compliance requirements. It's a harder, more interesting engineering and product problem than most AI applications get to work on, and it's why global enterprises like Indeed, Hexagon, Strava, Agilent, and Playrix trust us instead of building it in-house. We're a multicultural team working remotely from different parts of the world, with a culture built around flexibility, transparency, and ownership. We offer competitive compensation and an environment where people are trusted to do their best work. Join a fast-paced environment where you can directly shape the course of the company. Get real transparency into business strategy and decisions — you'll understand the big picture and your impact on it. Enjoy a balance of autonomy and responsibility: make decisions and own outcomes. Work on a genuinely hard problem — enterprise-grade translation quality — alongside people who've thought deeply about it. Get hands-on experience deploying AI systems into production for large global companies. Work alongside a talented team — engineering, linguistic, operational, and beyond — who care about doing the job well and supporting each other.

Descripción del puesto: After-Hours Pediatric Doctor Industry: Healthcare / Multi-Location Clinic Group Position: Full-Time, Remote Schedule: Overnight / After-Hours, 10am-6pm EST. Monday-Sunday About the Role We are seeking an experienced After-Hours Clinical Pediatric Doctor or doctor to provide overnight clinical support for a growing network of healthcare clinics. This doctor will serve as the first clinical point of contact for urgent patient-related situations that arise after regular business hours. The role requires someone who can quickly assess a situation, gather the appropriate clinical information, follow established protocols, and determine when a case needs to be escalated to the on-call provider or emergency services. This is a remote position requiring strong clinical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in urgent situations. Key Responsibilities Respond promptly to after-hours calls involving urgent patient concerns or changes in condition. Perform telephone-based clinical triage using established protocols and escalation guidelines. Ask appropriate clinical questions to assess the patient's situation and level of urgency. Determine whether a situation can be managed according to established protocols or requires escalation to an on-call physician/provider. Recognize potential medical emergencies and direct callers to emergency services when required by established protocols. Communicate with patients, families, caregivers, clinic staff, and on-call providers as needed. Provide clear instructions within the nurse's authorized scope of practice and company protocols. Document all calls, assessments, actions taken, recommendations, and escalations accurately. Ensure urgent matters are properly handed off to the appropriate clinical team. Follow up on unresolved overnight cases when required. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and organizational policies. Qualifications Doctor degree and active doctor license appropriate for the responsibilities of the position. Previous experience in nursing, clinical triage, urgent care, emergency care, home health, or another patient-facing clinical environment strongly preferred. Strong clinical assessment and critical-thinking skills. Ability to recognize warning signs and determine when immediate escalation is necessary. Excellent spoken and written English. Comfortable communicating with patients and families by phone. Calm, confident, and professional when handling stressful or urgent situations. Strong documentation and organizational skills. Comfortable working independently during overnight hours. Reliable internet connection and appropriate remote working environment. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is an experienced nurse who is calm under pressure, clinically knowledgeable, decisive, and an excellent communicator. They should be comfortable receiving an unexpected medical call, quickly gathering the relevant information, following established clinical protocols, and knowing when a situation must be escalated. This position is particularly well suited for a nurse with experience in telephone triage, emergency/urgent care, home health, outpatient care, or after-hours clinical support.

new_matches.description: Who We Are At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage. Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG. Join BCG Platinion's Enterprise Solutions team in our Middle East offices (Dubai, Riyadh) as an enterprise solutions expert, shaping and delivering AI-enabled transformation programs for major clients across the region. What You'll Do Support clients through end-to-end enterprise solutions transformation programs (covering ERP, CRM, HCM, SCM, Planning, Manufacturing), from strategy such as business case and roadmap definition, business process definition, technical reference architecture design and selection of solutions and implementation partners, through to implementation governance and quality assurance Design and deliver AI-enabled and agentic ERP use cases, from AI-accelerated delivery such as test generation, data migration and documentation, through to autonomous agents in financial close, procurement and order to cash, always within defined governance and data guardrails Introduce best practices from business requirements specification to solution implementation, minimizing one-off customizations and reducing maintenance costs Contribute to the Enterprise Solutions chapter at BCG Platinion by sharing your expertise, for example attending the most relevant conferences and events, researching and experimenting with the latest technology including GenAI and agentic AI, and authoring innovative articles What You'll Bring Education: An above average degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field, with strong academic performance preferred Experience: 3 to 4 years of relevant experience driving enterprise solutions transformation programs in CRM, ERP, HCM, SCM, Planning or Manufacturing, with SAP S/4HANA preferred. Strong candidates from 2 years will also be considered Functional knowledge: Solid grasp of typical end-to-end business processes (for example Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Lead-to-Quote, Record-to-Report, Hire-to-Retire) and how they are implemented Technical knowledge: Familiarity with industry specific solutions (for example SAP IS-OIL), add-ons (for example APO/IBP, Treasury/BCM, FSCM, Transportation Management, BPC/SEM), analytical tools (for example SAP BW/BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, Digital Boardroom) and AI-enabled ERP capabilities (for example SAP Joule and Business AI, S/4HANA embedded AI, agentic workflows on SAP BTP, clean core and extension strategy) AI fluency: Practical use of GenAI tools (for example ChatGPT, Claude) including the ability to validate and challenge output, with curiosity about applying agentic AI to ERP processes Soft skills: Excellent teamwork, communication and presentation skills, eager to learn and improve, with intellectual agility and a proven ability to align diverse stakeholders behind a common goal, exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking, and a strong client focus and results driven approach Language: Fluency in English, Arabic a strong plus Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across the region to client sites Who You'll Work With At BCG Platinion, we tackle our clients' most critical IT challenges at the intersection of business and technology. To meet this growing demand, we are expanding our Enterprise Solutions team. Partnering with clients, you will develop superior, business value driven ERP and application architecture strategies, concepts and roadmaps, applying your technical and functional process expertise to deliver high impact outcomes. new_matches.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission-critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high-altitude balloons. Silvus StreamCaster™ radios are being rapidly adopted by customers all over the world ranging from the U.S. and Allied Nations Departments of Defense to International, Federal, State, and Local Law Enforcement agencies, all the way to the Superbowl, Grammys, and industry-leading drone, robot, and unmanned systems manufacturers. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career. Participate in resource allocation and hardware maintenance to support different sales and business development activities. Help design engineers reproduce and troubleshoot problems; help drive future product development. Perform other related duties of which the above are representative. Travel up to 50% of the time for frequent travel for meetings, events, and demonstrations. Basic Requirements Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or international equivalent) in Electrical Engineering or other related technical fields, plus 2 years of demonstrated experience in a pre-and post-sales technical support position OR minimum completion of secondary education (such as GCSEs or an equivalent national qualification; high school diploma or GED) with at least 6 years of demonstrated experience in a pre- and post-sales technical support position. Willingness to travel to potential conflict areas in support of radios. All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check. Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Experience with operating and testing IP radios/modems. Familiarity with Linux. Proficiency with TCP/IP protocol and networking. Knowledge of wireless communication systems, RF signal propagation, and digital communication technologies. Exposure to and proficiency with programming languages such as C/C++. Working Conditions And Physical Requirements Trade shows. Outdoor environment for demonstrations. Occasional exposure to heat, cold, and allergens while performing tests or demonstrations in the field. Lift equipment up to 20 lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing. Travel Requirements Under 25% Relocation Provided International Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan No EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. new_matches.description: About Millennium Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. Our Israel office is located in the Bursa area of Ramat Gan. This role is on-site. As a global firm, proficiency in English is required. Meet the Team Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization develops the flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems that support the firm’s multi-manager platform. The Core AI Development Team focuses on the engineering environment, data pipelines, and AI systems that help the firm apply Large Language Models in daily workflows, including enterprise retrieval and document intelligence capabilities. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL and data ingestion pipelines that move documents from diverse source systems, including file shares, object stores, APIs, and databases, into the firm’s AI platform. Develop robust document understanding workflows, including parsing, layout analysis, OCR, text extraction, metadata extraction, and normalization across heterogeneous formats such as PDF, Office documents, HTML, and images. Implement chunking, cleaning, and enrichment strategies that improve retrieval quality and support downstream RAG systems. Build change-detection, deduplication, and incremental update mechanisms to keep large document corpora synchronized efficiently and reliably. Engineer pipelines for correctness, throughput, and resilience, with strong handling for malformed inputs, large files, and high-volume processing. Establish data quality checks, observability, and metrics so ingestion issues are identified early and resolved quickly. Partner with stakeholders to understand source systems and content requirements and translate them into reliable, production-ready ingestion solutions. Stay current with advances in AI, LLMs, document AI, and retrieval techniques, and apply relevant improvements to the team’s solutions. What You Bring 4+ years of experience and strong proficiency in Python, including building data pipelines, services, and APIs. Hands-on experience designing and developing ETL and data pipeline solutions, including processing large data volumes. Experience with document processing and text extraction, including PDF and Office document parsing, OCR, and unstructured content handling. Solid understanding of data modeling, transformation, and data quality best practices. Experience designing, building, testing, and debugging high-performance, reliable systems. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Familiarity with RAG systems and the impact of ingestion on retrieval quality, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and vector stores, is a plus.
